subject: Notice of third-party IP claim — proposed response and approval flow
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@neurolytics.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Benjamin Lowe <benjamin.lowe@lowelegal.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notice of Third‑Party IP Claim re: model outputs

Hi Kimberly,

We received a formal notice this morning alleging that outputs from the Redwood endpoint used in our product may infringe a third party patent. Attached is the claim notice and the screenshots the claimant provided (claim_notice.pdf). Our legal team (copied) asked me to reach out to confirm Redwood's position under the MSA / Order Form and to start the evidence exchange.

Can you please: 
- Confirm who at Redwood will be the primary contact for evidence and litigation routing,
- Confirm whether Redwood will accept defense for third‑party IP claims arising from model outputs as currently written in the MSA, and
- Provide an estimated timeline for a formal response and any requested materials from us.

We are noticing this to satisfy contractual notice timelines; Benjamin will follow up with a full evidence bundle if needed.

Thanks,
Sarah Nguyen
Head of Partnerships
Neurolytics, Inc.

Attachment: claim_notice.pdf (PDF, 237 KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@neurolytics.com>, Benjamin Lowe <benjamin.lowe@lowelegal.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Notice of Third‑Party IP Claim re: model outputs

Folks — forwarding Neurolytics' notice. Summary/context: Neurolytics is on our Growth plan (Order Form #DEAL-4873), monthly usage ~3M tokens, live in us-west. They got a 3P patent claim alleging model output infringement. They copied counsel.

Aditya: can you pull the order form and any past redlines or exceptions? I want the exact liability cap and whether they requested any additional carveouts during sales. Also please flag the customer success contact to coordinate evidence export (they asked for an evidence staging link).

Rishi: initial legal question — do we accept defense for these outputs under our current MSA language, or do we need to propose an amendment (defend vs reimburse, carveouts for generated content, cap alignment with order form)? I want a short, customer‑facing set of options we can send back today.

I'm attaching the evidence we have from Neurolytics (neurolytics_claim_bundle.zip). Please reply with recommended wording and timeline. If we can, let's avoid immediate escalation to leadership — aim for a contained addendum.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: neurolytics_claim_bundle.zip (8 files, 1.2 MB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@neurolytics.com>, Benjamin Lowe <benjamin.lowe@lowelegal.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Notice of Third‑Party IP Claim re: model outputs

Kim/Aditya — quick read and suggested pathway. High level: we should acknowledge receipt, request proof and chronology, and propose a narrowly tailored addendum that: (1) confirms Redwood's obligation to defend/reimburse for third‑party claims arising solely from our hosted model outputs, subject to customer cooperation and prompt notice; (2) limits Redwood's liability for such claims to the Order Form cap (no new unlimited exposure); and (3) excludes claims arising from customer's misuse, customer-supplied prompts/data, or models retrained by customer.

Draft language snippet for redline (high‑priority):
"Redwood will defend and indemnify Customer against third‑party claims alleging that the Hosted Model Outputs infringe a third‑party's intellectual property rights, provided that Customer: (a) provides prompt written notice of the claim; (b) grants Redwood sole control of the defense and settlement (except where settlement would require monetary relief from Customer); and (c) cooperates fully with Redwood's defense. Redwood's aggregate liability for indemnity obligations under this Section shall not exceed the liability cap set forth in the Order Form."

Operational asks: 
- We need the executed Order Form (Aditya) and the exact numeric cap.
- Neurolytics must stage any raw prompts, example outputs, and claimant materials to the Drive folder (link below). 
- Recommend a 10 business‑day initial review timeline for Redwood to produce a response plan; request 5 business days for Neurolytics to provide the evidence bundle.

I'll attach a short redline to send externally. If Neurolytics wants us to take defense control we will accept it subject to the cooperation and cap language above. We should avoid agreeing to indemnify for Customer‑modified models or for outputs where the customer provided the infringing content.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redline_suggestion.docx (Word, 12 KB)
Related: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-neurolytics-claim-evidence

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@neurolytics.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice of Third‑Party IP Claim re: model outputs — proposed addendum and next steps

Sarah / Benjamin — thanks for the notice and materials. Per our internal review, Redwood will proceed as follows unless you instruct otherwise: 

1) Acknowledge receipt and request full evidence bundle: please upload the raw prompts, outputs, and claimant materials to the Drive folder (link below) within 5 business days. We will not be able to evaluate merits without the raw artifacts.

2) Proposed contractual path: we propose a short addendum to the MSA/Order Form that (a) confirms Redwood's obligation to defend/reimburse for third‑party IP claims arising from Hosted Model Outputs, (b) limits Redwood's aggregate indemnity exposure to the Order Form liability cap, and (c) carves out claims arising from Customer misuse, customer‑provided infringing data, or customer‑retrained models. Draft attached (proposed_addendum.docx).

3) Defense control and cooperation: Redwood will seek primary defense control with an obligation to consult Customer on material settlements that require monetary relief from Customer. Customer cooperation (timely notices, access to materials, and a single technical point of contact) will be required.

4) Timeline: we propose Neurolytics provide evidence in 5 business days; Redwood will then provide a target response plan within 10 business days. If you agree to the addendum, we can execute via the DocuSign link below — please sign within 5 business days to lock in the timeline.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/XXXX-NEUROLYTICS-ADDENDUM
Drive (evidence staging): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-neurolytics-claim-evidence

If you prefer an alternative carveout approach (e.g., a narrower defend obligation with a higher cooperation threshold), let us know and we'll fast‑track alternative wording. We aim to keep this out of an exec escalation if possible.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_addendum.docx (Word, 18 KB)
